workflows.name: Deploy Fireball Web
workflows.rationale: Web deployment must not depend on hosted billing admission.

workflows.name: Deploy Fireball Worker
workflows.rationale: Worker deployment and migrations must execute on the approved zero-cost runner with explicit authentication gates.

workflows.name: External discovery inventory
workflows.rationale: Discovery is bounded and read-only; migrate away from hosted admission failure.

workflows.name: External source health
workflows.rationale: Read-only health test currently fails before a runner is allocated and is safe on Oracle.

workflows.name: External source reconcile
workflows.rationale: Already targets Oracle; add shared serialization and classified summary evidence.

workflows.name: External source registry health
workflows.rationale: Recent failures were zero-step hosted admission rejection; health validation is safe on Oracle.

workflows.name: External adapter sync
workflows.rationale: Two real Oracle runs already proved publication and idempotency; retain its hardening and add shared production serialization policy.

workflows.name: Full catalog ingestion and classification audit
workflows.rationale: Large catalog ingestion is production-affecting and cannot rely on hosted billing admission.

workflows.name: Mission 7.3 scheduled production federation
workflows.rationale: Federation is a production writer and must share the single-runner data serialization gate.

workflows.name: Mission 7.5 content policy sync
workflows.rationale: Publishes policy-filtered production data and must serialize with other data writers.

workflows.name: Oracle dedicated runner bootstrap
workflows.rationale: Registers and hardens the dedicated github-runner user on the Oracle host. workflow_dispatch only, so no fork pull request can reach it; it touches the runner host rather than production data.

workflows.name: Oracle A1 migration canary
workflows.rationale: Manual dispatch targets migration labels only; the opt-in production clone never publishes and cannot replace the E2 rollback runner.

workflows.name: Performance Testing
workflows.rationale: Non-production performance jobs are hosted-runner dependent; migration is optional and browser/tool capacity must be proven separately.

workflows.name: Automated Release
workflows.rationale: Release and production deployment must not depend on blocked hosted admission; deployment failures must remain fail-closed.

workflows.name: Security Scanning
workflows.rationale: All configured jobs are Linux-compatible; move them off hosted admission and classify optional Sonar as skipped.

workflows.name: Source Runtime Platform (Oracle self-hosted)
workflows.rationale: Runs the source runtime detector, replay and audit suite on the runtime-dedicated runner. workflow_dispatch only; reads production through the authenticated control plane and writes audits, not catalog data.

workflows.name: Test Suite
workflows.rationale: Linux jobs are portable but the matrix intentionally includes macOS compatibility coverage; keep that OS-specific requirement explicit.

workflows.name: Update Fireball data
workflows.rationale: Primary scheduled data writer; remove hosted billing dependency and serialize with all other production writers.

workflows.name: Visual Regression Testing
workflows.rationale: Browser installation is compatible with Linux but capacity validation is separate from production automation closure.

serialization_policy.rationale: The production host has exactly one self-hosted runner, so production-mutating jobs are physically serialized. GitHub keeps only one pending run per concurrency group; a shared group silently cancels a pending run from an unrelated workflow, which previously dropped real scheduled runs. Each production-mutation workflow declares its own concurrency group here, and validate_workflow_reliability.py fails closed when a workflow's concurrency.group drifts from this declaration.
serialization_policy.enforcement: validate_workflow_reliability.py compares every production_mutation workflow's concurrency.group to its manifest-declared concurrency_group; mismatch or missing declaration is a violation.
